title: Validate Phase 4A recovery with AiPet
scope: Run the retained Phase 4A recovery rehearsal against a clean, isolated AiPet checkout without upgrading or modifying the primary AiPet working tree.
acceptance_criteria: A verified Alpha.5 backup records the AiPet project ID, exact Git revision, clean source state, 21 files, and a stable content digest.
A stale restore plan is rejected after bounded fault injection, and a fresh plan reports one create, one replace, no conflicts, and upgrade_required=true.
Restore reproduces all 21 backup file digests in the isolated checkout without touching the primary AiPet working tree.
The isolated checkout upgrades from Alpha.5 to Alpha.24, generated views rebuild, and Doctor passes.
A validation record captures results and retained limits; no AiPet feature work, external release, or primary worktree mutation occurs.
